v_base: Tall vertical composition: a lone runner silhouette standing small at the bottom, at the foot of an enormous sheer black cliff that rises straight up to the top of the frame on the right side; he looks up at it; the left side is empty paper sky; a small crimson red sun high on the left.
v_climb: Tall vertical composition: a climber silhouette clinging exhausted to a sheer vertical black rock face on the right half, head hanging down, legs dangling; one thin crimson red horizontal line painted across the rock just above his head; the left half is empty paper.
v_head: Tall vertical composition: side profile of a man's bald head and neck in black silhouette filling the lower two thirds, facing left, the brain inside drawn in crimson red ink lines; the top third is empty paper.
v_control: Tall vertical composition: inside a dark control room, a small uniformed guard figure in silhouette pulling down a big red emergency lever, a crimson red warning lamp flashing above him, panels of dials around, black and crimson only.
v_governor: Tall vertical composition: close-up of a big round control dial with tick marks and a needle, a red stop pin blocking the needle far below the maximum, and a black hand holding the dial back; empty paper above and below.
v_track: Tall vertical composition: a running track seen from directly above, the lanes running from the bottom to the top of the frame, a finish line with a crimson red tape near the top, three runner silhouettes sprinting up toward it with motion lines.
v_tank: Tall vertical composition: front view silhouette of a standing athlete filling the frame; inside his torso a tall fuel tank with a window showing it is about sixty percent full of crimson red fuel; a heavy padlock on the tank's valve at the top.
v_shadow: Tall vertical composition: a small runner silhouette at the bottom of the frame facing a giant dark shadow figure that towers over him and raises one huge hand in a stop gesture; crimson red glow behind the shadow's head.
v_stairs: Tall vertical composition: a long staircase of steps rising steeply from the bottom of the frame to a summit at the top with a small crimson red flag, a runner silhouette climbing the middle steps, empty paper sky on both sides.
